name: nohup
summary: Runs a command that survives closing the terminal.
description: Runs a command while ignoring the SIGHUP signal, which is sent when you close the terminal or log out of an SSH session. Without a redirection, the output is written to nohup.out. It is almost always combined with & to get the prompt back immediately.

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description: Program to run, followed by its own options and arguments.

examples.explanation: Runs the script in the background; it keeps going even if you close the terminal.
examples.output: nohup: ignoring input and appending output to 'nohup.out'

examples.explanation: Runs a server in the background, sending its output and errors to server.log.
A long copy that is not interrupted if the SSH connection drops.
